title: Viva Insights: Copilot Analytics Agent Dashboard for agent adoption and Copilot Credit usage
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap record, the supplied tenant notice and Microsoft Learn. It correctly distinguishes the conflicting rollout dates and licensing descriptions, and preserves the preview, access and Copilot Credit reporting conditions.

claims.claim: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard to help leaders, delegates and analysts understand organisational agent adoption.
claims.quote: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents.

claims.claim: The notice describes agent adoption trends and associated Copilot Credit usage.
claims.quote: This dashboard provides visibility into key agent adoption trends and associated Copilot credit usage.

claims.claim: The notice covers agents used within Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: It supports insights into agents used within Microsoft 365 Copilot

claims.claim: The notice includes agents built using Copilot Studio, SharePoint or Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
claims.quote: Built using Microsoft Copilot Studio, SharePoint, or the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit

claims.claim: The notice includes agents built by employees, the organisation, Microsoft or Microsoft partners.
claims.quote: Built by employees, your organization, Microsoft, or Microsoft partners

claims.claim: The release adds agent insights to the Copilot Dashboard Adoption tab.
claims.quote: This release also enhances the Adoption tab of the Copilot Dashboard, allowing users to view agent insights directly

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard Adoption tab gains entry points to the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Direct entry points to the Agent Dashboard

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn marks the Copilot Agent Dashboard experience as public preview.
claims.quote: The Copilot Agent Dashboard view within the Agent Dashboard is for public preview customers only.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard has Copilot Agent Dashboard and Agent 365 Dashboard views.
claims.quote: It includes two different reporting experiences or views:

claims.claim: The Copilot Agent Dashboard view provides six months of reporting history.
claims.quote: This view of the dashboard provides insights only for agents used within Microsoft Copilot. Its reporting history covers the previous six months.

claims.claim: The Agent 365 Dashboard view reports on all supported agents used across Microsoft 365 apps.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Dashboard – Provides leaders and analysts with actionable insights into agent adoption and sessions, on all supported agents used across Microsoft 365 apps.

claims.claim: Selecting All agents switches to the Agent 365 Dashboard and clearing it switches to the Copilot Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: At the top right, select All agents to view the Agent 365 Dashboard. Clear All Agents to view the Copilot Agent Dashboard.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The All agents toggle does not appear unless the organisation meets the Agent 365 Dashboard licensing requirements.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Dashboard: The same licensing requirements as the Copilot Agent Dashboard view, plus Agent 365 licensing. If your organization doesn't meet this requirement, the All agents toggle won't appear in the dashboard.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Dashboard data represents the previous 28 days.
claims.quote: Data in the dashboard represents data over the previous 28 days.

claims.claim: Dashboard data can be delayed by up to six days.
claims.quote: There's up to a six-day data delay from the current date.

claims.claim: Agent names are suppressed for groups below the minimum group size.
claims.quote: To protect individual privacy, agent names and group metrics aren't shown for groups that are smaller than the minimum group size.

claims.claim: Group metrics are suppressed for groups below the minimum group size.
claims.quote: To protect individual privacy, agent names and group metrics aren't shown for groups that are smaller than the minimum group size.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard is on by default as part of the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard is on by default as part of the Viva Insights web app.

claims.where: summary; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard VFAM control can enable or disable this dashboard at tenant, group or user level.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level using the Agent Dashboard VFAM control in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Automatic senior-leader access requires a tenant with at least 2,500 Entra ID users.
claims.quote: The tenant has at least 2,500 users with an Entra ID

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Automatic senior-leader access requires the majority of tenant users to be in one reporting line.
claims.quote: The majority of users in the tenant are part of a single reporting line; for example, they report to the same CEO

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Automatically enabled senior leaders are in the top three organisational levels.
claims.quote: The user's in the top three levels in the organization.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Automatically enabled senior leaders have a significant portion of the organisation in their reporting line.
claims.quote: The user has a significant portion of the organization in their reporting line.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Global administrators are included among users with dashboard access, subject to the stated PIM caveat.
claims.quote: Users who are assigned the Global administrator role also have access to the Agent Dashboard.

claims.claim: Viva Insights analysts with global partition access have automatic dashboard access.
claims.quote: The following types of users also have automatic access to the Agent Dashboard: - Viva Insights Analysts with global partition access

claims.claim: Users with delegate access are included among dashboard users.
claims.quote: The following types of users also have automatic access to the Agent Dashboard: - Viva Insights Analysts with global partition access - Users with delegate access

claims.claim: Enabled managers with team-level Copilot Analytics access can see agent insights for the teams they are enabled to view.
claims.quote: Enabled managers who already have team-level access to Copilot Analytics in Viva Insights can also access the dashboard. Managers can see agent insights scoped to the teams they're enabled to view.

claims.claim: Automatic organisational access is based on the Entra ID manager hierarchy attribute.
claims.quote: Access is based on Microsoft Entra ID Data, specifically the manager hierarchy attribute.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Automatic-access criteria are re-evaluated weekly.
claims.quote: The criteria above are analyzed on a weekly basis to capture any major organization changes. Each week, any new users who meet the above criteria gain access to the dashboard.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Global administrators in PIM-enabled tenants might lack dashboard access and can be added explicitly.
claims.quote: If you're a Privileged Identity Management (PIM) enabled tenant, global admins might not have access to the Agent Dashboard. If you want to give global admins access to the Agent Dashboard, add them explicitly using these steps.

claims.claim: Delegation gives the delegate access to the delegating person's insights.
claims.quote: By granting delegate access, someone else at your company, such as your chief of staff or one of your direct reports, would have the same access you have to the insights.

claims.claim: A policy restricting dashboard access to specified users must explicitly include intended delegates.
claims.quote: If a custom policy restricts dashboard access to a defined set of users, delegates must be explicitly included in that policy to access the dashboards.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The dashboard's analysed population consists of employees who have had agent activity.
claims.quote: The analyzed population in the Agent Dashboard includes all employees who have had agent activity.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Dashboard reporting breaks down adoption by agent, group and agent creator type.
claims.quote: It shows which agents and groups are driving adoption, and who is creating the agents used across the organization

claims.claim: The default minimum group size is 10 employees.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.claim: The documented minimum group size setting must be at least five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five, then select Save.

claims.claim: Without an exclusion list, dashboard insights include employees with a Copilot licence, a Viva Insights licence or a manual cohort upload.
claims.quote: If you don't create an exclusion list, all employees who either have a Copilot license, a Viva Insights license, or are uploaded manually using the Cohort upload feature in the admin center, are included in dashboard insights and Viva Insights collaboration behavior reports.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The unified exclusion list hides specified employees from Agent Dashboard aggregates.
claims.quote: Your organization might want to exclude certain users from being included in the aggregated insights in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Agent Dashboard, Consumption Dashboard, or Viva Insights behavior collaboration reports in advanced analysis

claims.claim: The exclusion-list policy must be turned on for the exclusion list to work.
claims.quote: To use an exclusion list, you must turn on the policy.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents reporting rather than actions the dashboard takes on agents.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent Dashboard" "actions" "agents" Viva Insights. Opened learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/org-team-insights/agent-dashboard in full and its manage-settings-copilot-dashboard and delegate-access pages; documented report actions are viewing and filtering.

claims.claim: The preview experience may change before broader release.
claims.quote: Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.claim: The Copilot Chat licence filter appears only when the tenant has Copilot Chat reporting enabled.
claims.quote: The Copilot Chat filter appears only if your tenant has Copilot Chat reporting enabled.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: The Copilot Credits metric requires selecting Copilot Chat in the License filter.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits, which are only visible when you select Copilot Chat in the License filter at the top of the page and if your organization has enabled Pay-As-You-Go and used Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: The Copilot Credits metric additionally requires Pay-As-You-Go to be enabled and Copilot Credits to have been used.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits, which are only visible when you select Copilot Chat in the License filter at the top of the page and if your organization has enabled Pay-As-You-Go and used Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: The Active users using Copilot Credits metric requires the Copilot Chat licence filter, enabled Pay-As-You-Go and prior Copilot Credit use.

claims.claim: Neither Copilot Credits nor Active users using Copilot Credits is shown in the Agent 365 Dashboard view.
claims.quote: Active users using Copilot Credits, which is only visible when you select Copilot Chat in the License filter at the top of the page and if your organization has enabled Pay-As-You-Go and used Copilot Credits. (Not shown if viewing the Agent 365 Dashboard.)

claims.quote: Searched: "Agent Dashboard" "meter"; Viva Insights Agent Dashboard dashboard itself pricing meter actions agents reporting. Opened the Agent Dashboard page in full and the Copilot Dashboard licensing table; they describe reporting on credit use, not a dashboard meter.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page gives no separate price for the dashboard.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent Dashboard" "price" "Viva". Opened learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/org-team-insights/agent-dashboard in full and the copilot-dashboard licensing table; no separate dashboard price is stated.

claims.quote: Leaders, delegates, adoption specialists, and administrators using Microsoft Viva Insights

claims.where: Scope: Who and where; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn says the Agent Dashboard is currently unavailable in national or regional clouds, including U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard isn't currently available for national/regional cloud deployments including but not limited to Microsoft's U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.

claims.claim: The settings page allows AI Administrators and Microsoft 365 Global Administrators to manage the access settings.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators. / Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: The general VFAM feature table lists Global admin for the web app control, whereas it lists Global admin or AI admin for Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Agent Dashboard | No | Global admin or AI admin | Viva Insights / Viva Insights web app | No | Global admin | Viva Insights

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard policy UI is under Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Agent Dashboard > Add policy.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. On this page, go to the Set up and management tab. / Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. / select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId AgentDashboard, Name DisableFeatureForAll, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates the documented tenant-wide disabling policy.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant / ModuleId : VivaInsights / FeatureId : AgentDashboard / Name : DisableFeatureForAll / IsFeatureEnabled : false / Everyone

claims.claim: Web app user and group access assignments are managed at Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. On this page, go to the Set up and management tab. / Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId "Viva Insights web app", Name DisableFeatureForAll, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates the documented tenant-wide web app disabling policy.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant / ModuleId : VivaInsights / FeatureId : Viva Insights web app / Name : DisableFeatureForAll / IsFeatureEnabled : false / Everyone

claims.claim: The second row's UI adds or removes user and group assignments, and does not give the AI Administrator automatic app access.
claims.quote: You can turn access to the Viva Insights web app on or off for individual users or groups using Microsoft Entra ID. / The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app.

claims.claim: Turning off the Viva Insights web app disables the whole app, including the Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: A user needs both the Viva Insights web app control and Agent Dashboard control enabled to access the dashboard.
claims.quote: To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy is an Exchange Online PowerShell cmdlet that creates feature access policies using the parameters printed in both calls.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in the Exchange Online PowerShell module version 3.2.0 or later. / Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -FeatureId <String> -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean> -ModuleId <String> -Name <String> [-Confirm] [-Everyone]

claims.claim: Up to 10 policies can be assigned per feature, with one additional tenant-wide policy.
claims.quote: You can assign up to 10 policies per feature. An additional one policy per feature can be assigned to the entire tenant.

claims.claim: User or group policies outrank the tenant policy; the most restrictive policy wins among multiple applicable user or group policies.
claims.quote: Policies assigned to a specific user or group take priority over the policy assigned to the entire tenant when determining whether a feature is enabled. If a user has multiple policies assigned for a feature (directly as a user or member of a group), the most restrictive policy applies.

claims.claim: AutoCxoIdentification controls dashboard auto-enablement and supports tenant-level policies only.
claims.quote: This feature access control allows AI Administrators to enable or disable the auto-enablement feature for the Viva Insights web app in their tenant. This control supports tenant-level policies only, not user or group-level policies. / FeatureId : AutoCxoIdentification

claims.claim: Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility can exclude non-public agents, leaving public agents in Agent 365 Dashboard reporting.
claims.quote: You can also use VFAM to set whether reporting in the Agent 365 Dashboard view includes non-public agents, or only agents available to all users in the organization. / FeatureId : Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility / IsFeatureEnabled : false

claims.claim: Without a Viva Insights licence, minimum group size is set at Settings > Microsoft Viva > Microsoft Viva Insights > Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365 > Manage minimum group size.
claims.quote: If your tenant does not have a Viva Insights license, use these steps to set the minimum group size: / go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights. / Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy requires membership in the Global Administrators role or a role assigned at the feature level.
claims.quote: Currently, you need to be a member of the Global Administrators role or the roles that have been assigned at the feature level to run this cmdlet.
